# CII Smart Manufacturing

> A national, industry-led platform helping Indian manufacturers assess readiness, discover solutions, learn from peers, and build capabilities for sustainable Industry 4.0 transformation.

CII Smart Manufacturing connects MSMEs and large enterprises with readiness assessments, case studies, training programmes, research reports, and a partner ecosystem to accelerate digital adoption on the shop floor.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform, featured programmes, resources, and pathways to start the smart-manufacturing journey.
- [About](/about): Mission, pillars, platform journey, ecosystem, and progress of the CII Smart Manufacturing initiative.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the CII Smart Manufacturing team.
- [Reports](/reports): Research reports, whitepapers, and industry insights on Industry 4.0 adoption in India.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming conferences, summits, webinars, roundtables, and training events.
- [Programmes](/programmes): Training, certification, and capability-building programmes for manufacturers.
- [Knowledge Hub](/solutions): Curated solution areas, case studies and resources mapped to manufacturing outcomes.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Real-world transformation stories from Indian manufacturing companies.
- [Readiness Assessment](/readiness-assessment): Self-assessment tools to evaluate Industry 4.0 readiness.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use and legal information.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling practices.

## Optional

- [Report detail](/reports/:slug): Individual report download and summary pages.
- [Event detail](/events/:slug): Detailed event agendas, speakers, and registration.
- [Programme detail](/programmes/:slug): Individual programme curriculum, schedule, and enrollment.
- [Solution detail](/solutions/:slug): Deep-dive into specific technology solutions and providers.
- [Case Study detail](/case-studies/:slug): Detailed breakdown of a single transformation case study.
- [Assessment detail](/readiness-assessment/:slug): Specific assessment modules and results.
